title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
style: 浅彩六栏机器人流程图
description: The simulator inside PhysLoop supplies physical constraints and observable outcomes, allowing the harness to check whether the generated behavior satisfies the intended physical requirements. Feedback from these outcomes guides the LLM in correcting how its knowledge is applied, while repeated assessment determines which videos are suitable to retain.
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Overview of PhysLoop and its two applications: training-data construction and video repair. The harness guides LLMs to identify physical errors and generate physically consistent videos through simulators and other tools.
